HomePage.title: Retake
HomePage.description: Fix the flaws in a recording without starting over — by typing what you want changed, or by hand on the timeline.

dropzone.title: Drop a video here, or click to choose one
dropzone.hint: MP4, WebM or MOV. It stays on your computer — nothing is uploaded yet.

notAVideo.title: That file isn't a video
notAVideo.description: {name} doesn't look like a video file. Choose an MP4, WebM or MOV.

unplayable.title: This browser can't play that video
unplayable.description: {name} may use a format or codec your browser doesn't support. Try an MP4 (H.264) or WebM file.

cleanup.hint: Removes flagged silences and filler words in one step.
cleanup.nothing: Nothing flagged that can be removed automatically.
cleanup.estimate: This will remove approximately {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
cleanup.breakdown: ({silences, plural, one {# silence} other {# silences}}, {fillers, plural, one {# filler word} other {# filler words}})
cleanup.fillersForReview: {count, plural, one {# filler word runs} other {# filler words run}} straight into the next word with no clear pause, so {count, plural, one {it stays} other {they stay}} flagged (outlined) for you to cut by hand.
cleanup.resetConfirm: Reset to the original take? This removes every trim, cut, clip change and re-recorded sentence. Undo brings them all back.

fillerCut.label: Cut editor for "{word}"
fillerCut.title: Cut "{word}" at {at}
fillerCut.hint: Drag the handles until only the filler is inside, then listen both ways. Dips below the dashed line are pauses.

clips.label: Clips
clips.clipLabel: Clip {number}: plays {duration}, from {source} of the take
clips.reorderHint: Drag a clip, or press Alt+← / Alt+→ on it, to change the order.
clips.selectionHint: Click a clip to select it, Shift+click to select a run of clips to merge.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.no_audio: This video has no audio track to transcribe.
transcript.too_long: Transcripts work on clips up to 5 minutes for now. Silences are still flagged on the timeline.

confirm.plan: I'll keep {start}–{end} ({kept} s) and remove the rest of the clip ({removed} s).
confirm.title: I'll show the title “{text}” from {start} to {end} of the edited video.
confirm.watermarkNew: I'll put your logo in the {corner} corner for the whole video. Choose the PNG next.
confirm.watermarkMove: I'll move the watermark to the {corner} corner.
confirm.captionsOn: I'll turn captions on, from the transcript.

unsupported.title: I can't do that yet.
unsupported.commandsIntro: As a typed command, I can:
unsupported.trimRange: Keep a time range: “cut from 2 to 5 seconds”, “keep 1:05 to 1:20”
unsupported.trimToEnd: Keep from a point to the end: “cut from 3 seconds to the end”
unsupported.addTitle: Add a title card: “add the title Welcome for the first 3 seconds”
unsupported.addWatermark: Add a logo watermark: “put my logo in the top-right corner”
unsupported.captions: Turn captions on or off: “turn captions on”
unsupported.editorIntro: In the editor itself, you can also:
unsupported.cleanup: Remove long silences and filler words with Clean up recording
unsupported.fillerCut: Cut a single filler word by clicking its flag on the timeline
unsupported.handTrim: Trim by hand by dragging the timeline's handles
unsupported.split: Split a clip at the playhead with Split at playhead
unsupported.reorder: Reorder clips by dragging them in the Clips strip
unsupported.merge: Merge adjacent clips by selecting them and choosing Merge clips
unsupported.export: Export the edit as a video file with Export video
unsupported.graphics: Add or change a title and watermark in the Graphics panel
unsupported.reRecord: Re-record a sentence by clicking the microphone next to it in the transcript

out_of_range.title: That range isn't in this clip.
out_of_range.description: Pick a start before the end, both within 0:00–{duration}.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.fillerCount: {count, plural, one {# filler word} other {# filler words}}
timeline.fillerPinLabel: Filler word "{word}" at {at}. Open the cut editor
timeline.fillerReviewPinLabel: Filler word "{word}" at {at}, needs a manual cut (no clear pause around it). Open the cut editor
timeline.empty: Your timeline appears here once a video loads.

graphics.label: Graphics
graphics.titleHint: Times are in the edited video: 0 is where the export starts.
graphics.captionsHint: From the transcript, over the bottom of the video.

notAPng.title: That isn't a PNG
notAPng.description: {name} can't be used as a watermark. Choose a PNG image.

speed.label: Preview speed
speed.hint: Only how fast the editor plays. The export always runs at normal speed.

export.hint: Plays the edit through once to record it, so it takes as long as the edit runs. Keep this tab open and in front.

unsupported.title: This browser can't export video.
unsupported.description: Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

reRecord.label: Re-record the sentence at {at}
reRecord.title: Re-record the sentence at {at}
reRecord.hint: Say the sentence again. Your new take replaces the original sound; the picture keeps playing underneath, so say it to match what is on screen.

blocked.no_gap_before: There is no clear pause before this sentence, so a new take can’t be joined in without cutting into speech.
blocked.no_gap_after: There is no clear pause after this sentence, so a new take can’t be joined in without cutting into speech.
blocked.trimmed: Part of this sentence is trimmed away. Move the trim handles to include all of it first.
blocked.split: This sentence is split between two clips. Merge them first.
blocked.overlaps: This sentence overlaps one you’ve already re-recorded.

reRecord.recording: Recording… say the sentence, pause a moment, then press Stop.
reRecord.noSpeech: No speech was heard in that recording. Check your microphone and try again.

micUnavailable.title: Can’t use the microphone
micUnavailable.description: Allow microphone access for this site and check a microphone is connected, then try again.

reRecord.stoppedMidSpeech: Stop was pressed while you were still speaking, so the end of the take would be cut off. Record again, and pause a moment before pressing Stop.
